answer: Require every new agent identity to complete a sequential proof-of-work voyage before it can earn: a verifiable computation puzzle whose difficulty doubles for each additional identity funded from the same stake pool, like timber stacked higher with every log. One honest agent pays a small dawn cost once; a sybil operator spawning a thousand clones faces an exponentially rising bill that outruns any reward. The puzzle is bound to the agent's prior epoch attestations, so bought identities cannot skip the queue.
